helpCenter.title: Help Center
helpCenter.importPapersDesc: AcaSight supports multiple ways to import papers, including PDF upload, Zotero sync, and online search import.
helpCenter.importStep1: Click the "Library" icon on the left to open the library
helpCenter.importStep2: Click the "Upload PDF" button and select local PDF files
helpCenter.importStep3: The system will automatically parse PDF metadata (title, authors, abstract, etc.)
helpCenter.importStep4: You can also import papers via Zotero sync or AI search
helpCenter.aiAssistantDesc: The AI assistant can help you analyze papers, answer questions, generate summaries, etc. It supports RAG mode and chat mode.
helpCenter.aiStep1: Click the "Academic Agent" icon on the left to open the AI assistant panel
helpCenter.aiStep2: Enter your question or command in the input box
helpCenter.aiStep3: Choose RAG mode (answer based on papers) or Chat mode (free conversation)
helpCenter.startWritingDesc: The AI writing workspace provides a complete writing flow from topic selection to export, supporting outline generation, section writing, and polishing.
helpCenter.writingStep1: Click the "AI Writing Workspace" icon on the left
helpCenter.writingStep2: Enter the paper topic and subject area, select paper type
helpCenter.writingStep3: Click "Generate Outline" and AI will generate a paper outline for you
helpCenter.writingStep4: Generate content section by section or all at once, then export as Word/LaTeX/PDF
helpCenter.apiOpenaiDesc: Configure OpenAI API to use GPT-4o / GPT-4 models.
helpCenter.apiOpenaiStep1: Go to platform.openai.com to register and get an API Key
helpCenter.apiOpenaiStep2: Select "OpenAI" provider in Settings → AI Model
helpCenter.apiOpenaiStep3: Enter the API Key, default API address is https://api.openai.com/v1
helpCenter.apiOpenaiStep4: Click "Test Connection" to verify, then save after success
helpCenter.apiDeepseekDesc: Configure DeepSeek API to use V3 / R1 models with excellent cost-performance ratio.
helpCenter.apiDeepseekStep1: Go to platform.deepseek.com to register and get an API Key
helpCenter.apiDeepseekStep2: Select "DeepSeek" provider in Settings → AI Model
helpCenter.apiDeepseekStep3: Enter the API Key, default API address is https://api.deepseek.com/v1
helpCenter.apiDeepseekStep4: Click "Test Connection" to verify, then save after success
helpCenter.apiGlmDesc: Configure Zhipu GLM API to use GLM-4 Flash / Plus models.
helpCenter.apiGlmStep1: Go to open.bigmodel.cn to register and get an API Key
helpCenter.apiGlmStep2: Select "Zhipu GLM" provider in Settings → AI Model
helpCenter.apiGlmStep3: Enter the API Key, default API address is https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4
helpCenter.apiGlmStep4: Click "Test Connection" to verify, then save after success
helpCenter.apiOllamaDesc: Configure Ollama to use local large models. No internet required, data stays completely local.
helpCenter.apiOllamaStep1: Install Ollama (ollama.com), run ollama pull to download models
helpCenter.apiOllamaStep2: Select "Ollama" provider in Settings → AI Model
helpCenter.apiOllamaStep3: Default API address is http://localhost:11434/v1, no API Key needed
helpCenter.apiOllamaStep4: Click "Test Connection" to verify, then save after success
helpCenter.apiSiliconflowDesc: Configure SiliconFlow API to use aggregated models like Qwen / DeepSeek / GLM.
helpCenter.apiSiliconflowStep1: Go to siliconflow.cn to register and get an API Key
helpCenter.apiSiliconflowStep2: Select "SiliconFlow" provider in Settings → AI Model
helpCenter.apiSiliconflowStep3: Enter the API Key, default API address is https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1
helpCenter.apiSiliconflowStep4: Click "Test Connection" to verify, then save after success
helpCenter.apiClaudeDesc: Configure Claude API to use Claude 3.5 Sonnet / Opus models.
helpCenter.apiClaudeStep1: Go to console.anthropic.com to register and get an API Key
helpCenter.apiClaudeStep2: Select "Claude" provider in Settings → AI Model
helpCenter.apiClaudeStep3: Enter the API Key, default API address is https://api.anthropic.com/v1
helpCenter.apiClaudeStep4: Click "Test Connection" to verify, then save after success
helpCenter.apiMinimaxDesc: Configure MiniMax API to use abab6.5s / abab7 models.
helpCenter.apiMinimaxStep1: Go to platform.minimaxi.com to register and get an API Key
helpCenter.apiMinimaxStep2: Select "MiniMax" provider in Settings → AI Model
helpCenter.apiMinimaxStep3: Enter the API Key and Group ID
helpCenter.apiMinimaxStep4: Click "Test Connection" to verify, then save after success
helpCenter.error401Answer: API Key is invalid or expired. Please check if the API Key is correct, has no extra spaces, and your account has sufficient balance.
helpCenter.error429Answer: Too many requests triggered the rate limit. Please retry later, or switch to another API provider in settings. You can also upgrade your API plan for higher rate limits.
helpCenter.error500Answer: The API server encountered an error. This is usually a temporary provider issue. Please retry later. If it persists, check if the API address is correct.
helpCenter.errorTimeoutAnswer: Unstable network connection or slow API response. Please check your network, try increasing the timeout, or switch to a lower-latency API provider.
helpCenter.xrdGuideDesc: XRD stacked plots are used to compare multiple X-ray diffraction datasets, with support for auto peak finding, annotation, and journal themes.
helpCenter.xrdStep2: Upload or paste XRD data files (supports .xy, .dat, .csv formats)
helpCenter.xrdStep3: Adjust offset, color, and annotation parameters
helpCenter.xrdStep4: Select a journal theme and export high-resolution image
helpCenter.rsm3dGuideDesc: Response surface 3D plots visualize the relationship between factors and responses in Design of Experiments (DOE).
helpCenter.rsm3dStep2: Input or import experimental data (factors and response values)
helpCenter.rsm3dStep3: Select fitting model and 3D display parameters, then export
helpCenter.spectrumGuideDesc: The spectrum processing engine supports baseline correction, smoothing, peak finding, and more for Raman, XPS, FTIR, UV-Vis spectra.
helpCenter.spectrumStep1: In Plot Studio, select the corresponding spectrum type
helpCenter.spectrumStep2: Upload spectrum data, select preprocessing methods (baseline correction, smoothing, normalization, etc.)
helpCenter.spectrumStep3: Adjust parameters and export processed results and images
helpCenter.journalThemeDesc: Support one-click switching between Nature, Science, ACS and other journal styles to ensure figures meet submission requirements.
helpCenter.themeStep1: Click the "Journal Theme" button at the bottom of the plot panel
helpCenter.themeStep2: Select the target journal style from the dropdown list
helpCenter.themeStep3: The figure will automatically apply the corresponding journal's font, color, and size specifications
helpCenter.exportHdDesc: Support exporting 300+ DPI high-resolution images that meet SCI journal submission requirements.
helpCenter.exportStep1: After finishing the figure editing, click the "Export" button
helpCenter.exportStep2: Select export format (PNG / SVG / PDF) and resolution
helpCenter.exportStep3: Click confirm to export, the image will be saved locally
helpCenter.faqPdfParse: PDF cannot be parsed, what to do?
helpCenter.faqPdfParseAnswer: Make sure the PDF is not encrypted and contains an extractable text layer. Scanned PDFs need OCR processing first. If the issue persists, try re-uploading or using a different PDF file.
helpCenter.faqAiSlow: AI response is slow, how to optimize?
helpCenter.faqAiSlowAnswer: 1) Switch to a faster model (e.g., DeepSeek V3 or GLM-4 Flash); 2) Use Ollama local models to avoid network latency; 3) Reduce input text length; 4) Check if network connection is stable.
helpCenter.faqDataExport: How to export and backup data?
helpCenter.faqDataExportAnswer: Click the "Data Export/Import" feature on the left, select the workspace to export, optionally include historical snapshots, and export as a JSON file. To restore, upload the JSON file.
helpCenter.faqZotero: Zotero connection failed, what to do?
helpCenter.faqZoteroAnswer: 1) Make sure Zotero is running; 2) Check if Better BibTeX plugin is installed; 3) Confirm that Zotero's local API port (default 23119) is not blocked by firewall; 4) Check Zotero URL in settings.
helpCenter.faqWhiteboardAnswer: Click the "Whiteboard" icon on the left to open the whiteboard panel. It supports free drawing, text input, shape drawing, and image insertion. Export to PNG format is supported. You can also drag AI-generated flowcharts into the whiteboard for editing.
helpCenter.faqBatchImportAnswer: 1) Batch import via Zotero sync: connect Zotero and click "Import All"; 2) Batch import via AI search: click "Import" for each result; 3) Upload multiple PDFs: drag and drop multiple files in the library.
helpCenter.aboutDesc: AcaSight is an intelligent research workstation for researchers, integrating literature management, AI assistance, scientific plotting, and paper writing to empower efficient academic research.
